humanTitle: People run out of energy before they finish two lessons
whoItAffects: iPhone users in Canada, the United Kingdom and Ireland, across three app versions.

build.proposition: A free tier metered by time practised rather than by mistakes made.
specifics: Refill on a schedule a learner can plan a day around
Show the refill clock before the lesson starts, not once it stops
Never end a session in the middle of an exercise
build.limitation: The limit is what persuades people to pay, so loosening it is a pricing decision rather than a design one.

start.proposition: Practice software where the daily amount is fixed and paid for once.
specifics: One price, no meter, and no interruption at the point of learning
Aimed at adults returning to a language after years away
start.limitation: A one-off price funds one version, and language material needs constant upkeep to stay worth opening.

study.proposition: What happens to a practice habit when a meter sets the session length?
specifics: Track streak length either side of the version that added the meter
Ask whether a short forced break helps retention or ends it
study.limitation: Spaced practice genuinely works, so a meter and good teaching can look identical from outside the app.

write.proposition: The lesson that stops in the middle of itself.
specifics: Set the meter beside the streak it interrupts
Quote the learner cut down to ten minutes a day
write.limitation: Free tiers tightening is a well-covered beat, and only the exact stopping point is new here.
